# [3.0.0](https://github.com/VincentHardouin/opencode-snip/compare/v2.0.0...v3.0.0) (2026-10-18)


* feat!: keep the plugin loadable on OpenCode v2, which no longer runs v1 plugins ([a328093](https://github.com/VincentHardouin/opencode-snip/commit/a328093d76687123b1bd02456daf562daa13a22d))


### BREAKING CHANGES

* OpenCode v1 is no longer supported. v1 users should stay on opencode-snip@2.

# [3.0.0-next.1](https://github.com/VincentHardouin/opencode-snip/compare/v2.0.0...v3.0.0-next.1) (2026-10-01)

### BREAKING CHANGES

* OpenCode v1 is no longer supported. v1 users should stay on opencode-snip@2.

# [2.0.0](https://github.com/VincentHardouin/opencode-snip/compare/v1.6.1...v2.0.0) (2026-09-30)


* feat!: reuse snip's own rewrite engine to stop corrupting piped and redirected output ([4ad49da](https://github.com/VincentHardouin/opencode-snip/commit/4ad49da310aaa669a02549048bd9d7b28543f668))


### Bug Fixes

* disable the plugin loudly when installed snip has no hook subcommand ([6784bdc](https://github.com/VincentHardouin/opencode-snip/commit/6784bdc9440ed36cd8707b57f382b6f45a505e54))


### BREAKING CHANGES

* commands are rewritten to `"<snip path>" run -- <command>`
instead of `snip <command>`, only when snip has a filter for them. Requires
a snip version providing `snip hook` (tested with v0.25.2).

### Features

issues.title: snips are getting more and more stacked
SSH commands break: OPERATOR_RE splits on ; snip inside quoted strings, injecting snip into remote commands
Can `snip` only be used for adapted commands? Otherwise, exceptions often occur in other commands.
Snip only runs on the first command
Inline environment variables with command substitution not handled correctly
Windows/PowerShell: plugin breaks env guards and fails on cmdlets
